## SqliteGrammar class

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

Compiles blueprints to sqlite DDL.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class SqliteGrammar extends Grammar 
```
**Extends:** [Grammar](./database.grammar.md)

## Remarks

sqlite has few types, so most columns collapse onto `text`<!-- -->, `integer`<!-- -->, `real` or `numeric`<!-- -->. Booleans become `1`<!-- -->/`0` integers and timestamps become ISO-8601 text, which is what makes reading a sqlite row differ from Postgres.

Auto-increment keys must be spelled `integer primary key autoincrement` exactly, so a `bigInteger`<!-- -->-shaped key is still declared `integer`<!-- -->.
